name: Arrow Scroll Carousel
description: Horizontally scrollable row of square image tiles with floating glass arrow buttons that appear only when more content exists in that direction and scroll the row smoothly.
contents: Row of square rounded image tiles
Previous and next circular arrow buttons
behavior: Native horizontal scroll with hidden scrollbar
Arrows scroll by a set number of tiles with smooth scrolling
Arrows fade in and out depending on scroll position
Images zoom slightly and brighten on hover
editableByProps: Images and alt text, tile size, gap and scroll distance

needsCodeEdit.change: Change tile corner radius or shadow

needsCodeEdit.where: left-8 md:left-16 and right-8 md:right-16 classes on the buttons

fixed: Adds a global rule hiding the scrollbar of the no-scrollbar class
